changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM m_role r CROSS JOIN m_permission p WHERE r.id = 1 AND p.code IN ('CREATE_SELFSERVICEUSER', 'READ_SELFSERVICEUSER', 'UPDATE_SELFSERVICEUSER') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id );
